about: ASSET-005 early repaint recipe: the Hive Brute's method (kit_tools/troll_repaint.py) scaled to the Draugr (distances / 2.3). Mask = repaint/husk_hive_mask.png in DraugrMesh1 UV0 (R bark, G extremity darkening, B blight veins = emission, A dark roots), lines computed at 2048 and box-filtered to 1024. Colours are linear multipliers on the texture's stored texel values, as the runtime reads them back; the vanilla luminance is kept (lum / mean lum) so the Draugr still reads.
bark_texture: olivetree_trunk01 (TheHive_Mat _MainTex), triplanar in rest-pose metres, tile 0.52 m
draugr_eye_glow_note: multiplier on the Draugr's own _EmissionColor (its green eyes under the brow), so the Hive eyes lead
veins: off the head and the hair/beard cards; faded out within 0.25-0.5 m of the Hive eyes
